speaker: Samantha
text: Since Yang's momentous journey, China has made a gigantic progress in space exploration, and more astronauts have been sent into orbit. The astronauts have performed scientific experiments and technological tests, undertaken extravehicular activities, and even delivered a science lecture watched by tens of millions of students.
